scope: Read-only v5 launch/code/frozen-policy audit plus five local fixture reproductions; no provider HTTP; no production source, .env, proxy, daily DB or server changes.
conclusion: 未发现 v5 实际调用链存在启用的 300 秒主动超时；受控生产 Runtime/ModelClient 能越过 300 秒并在 310 秒接受 finish_analysis。真实请求的 RemoteProtocolError 仍不能凭此归因供应商，也不能排除流解析等其他本地缺陷。

launch_review.launcher: python scripts/verify_fifteenth_aggregate.py --run-real with prepared isolated v5 directory and bounded shared attempt ledger
launch_review.reported_by_executing_parent: exec_command yielded session 10448; only empty stdin polls; no shell timeout, Ctrl-C, kill or terminate; process returned exit 2; functions.exec yield did not stop session

boundaries.finding: Direct ResearchRuntime.run; pre-request durable attempt reservation contains no timer; finally closes runtime only after run result/error. No Service worker is launched.

Manager has analysis 1200s and synthesis request phase. Ordinary 300s is used by closeout planning only. agent_timeout 600s applies child runners; v5 has no children. No inherited formal/analysis deadline in verifier context.
Policy selected from synthesis phase; explicit HTTPX timeout connect15/pool15/write30/readNone. Hard timeout and parent cancellation have separate handlers from HTTP RequestError.
Synthesis hard field 360 wins over legacy synthesis120 and ordinary300.

Read-only source inspection: explicit read=None reaches receive-body network read. Cancellation is BaseException, excluded from HTTPX Exception mapping; HTTP/1.1 body and pool cleanup re-raise original exception. Incomplete chunk EOF is h11 RemoteProtocolError. No hidden total300 timer found in inspected path.

local_reproduction.method: Real ResearchRuntime, ModelClient, ResearchTools and isolated SQLite; only transport and coherent monotonic/asyncio/perf clock controlled. Same safe v5 timeout values; semantic progress at10/80/150/212.55953s, heartbeat250.33911s. Request extension confirms read=None; one request, no children in every case. Source snapshot hash was not independently captured at reproduction start; this is scoped diagnostic evidence, not a new full-suite identity.

limits: MockTransport controls the exception; this suite proves application timer/cancellation behavior, not actual upstream or intermediary failure origin.
No raw stream is retained; v5 cannot be retrospectively replayed to prove whether terminal framing or progress events were misparsed.
Supplier client_gone identifies that endpoint's observed disconnect, not which component initiated it.
Pending local stream parser fixes are reviewed separately; no paid retry was authorized by this audit.
